listing.name: Mario Kart Wii / KartPad (chrissotraidis)
listing.summary: Build your own KartPad Mac app through upstream setup and keep its game data, saves and controller features.

steps.title: Prepare your Mac copy upstream
steps.instruction: On an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 14 or newer and Xcode, use the current PadMint and choose Mario Kart Wii, your own supported PAL RMCP01 revision 0 disc and This Mac. Follow KartPad's current Mac guide and game-owned build recipe. Keep completed builds and original files. The ready-made Mac releases from 0.7.9 through 0.7.13 are a legacy alternative and receive no updates; current mobile packages are not Mac players. If a tool download fails, keep certificate verification enabled and use upstream troubleshooting or its documented manual build.

steps.title: Keep the complete app and reuse your game data
steps.instruction: Move the completed KartPad app to Applications and open it using upstream macOS instructions. When it asks for game data, choose your existing matching extracted DATA folder, or copy PadMint's prepared disc folder to a location you will keep. Reuse valid remembered choices. Retro Rewind needs the exact version named by this app and its separate whole data folder; replacing mod data alone does not update translated game code. Keep upstream Data, controls, Mii and save tools.

steps.title: Keep your actual saves and profile recoverable
steps.instruction: Before a rebuild or update, close KartPad and back up ~/Library/Application Support/KartPad, your chosen original-game files, and the whole enclosing Retro Rewind folder because it can hold saves beside the selected data. Keep ~/Library/Caches/KartPad and custom roots if needed, the current working app and your original disc. Changing player folders does not isolate the existing profile. Preserve the app and signing identity; do not uninstall or clear data to update.

steps.title: Use the app or optionally register its native player
steps.instruction: Opening the finished app upstream is the simplest route. To keep an existing copy in Portcove, select KartPad.app/Contents/MacOS/KartPad, keep the complete app intact, and use its Contents/MacOS folder as the working directory. Save launch details without starting it, then choose Play explicitly. Upstream update notices do not replace the app: rebuild the compatible version, close the old app, preserve its profile and replace the app. You or upstream own updates and data backups; Portcove registration supplies no managed Update, Backup or Rollback, and removal leaves every external file untouched.
